vulkan.note: Optional (--vulkan). Needs the Vulkan headers and glslc at build time; libvulkan.so.1 comes from the user's graphics stack and is never bundled. Not built in CI: the runners have no GPU to test it.

provenanceNotes: The whisper.cpp repository, tag, commit, licence digest and JFK fixture are read from scripts/windows-local-runtime/dependencies.json, so the Windows and Linux runtimes are built from one pin and the vendored headers in Sources/CWindowsSupport/whisper-cpp describe both.

GGML_BACKEND_DL with GGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS builds one CPU backend per x86-64 feature level; LinuxWhisper.c loads the best one the CPU reports from the runtime directory only, never through GGML_BACKEND_PATH, the current directory or the library search path.

CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH leaves the libraries without RPATH or RUNPATH: the loader opens libggml-base, libggml and libwhisper by absolute path in dependency order, so their sonames resolve to those copies and nothing is searched for.
OpenMP is off, so no libgomp is needed; ggml's own thread pool runs the CPU backend.

Library hashes depend on the build image's compiler and C++ runtime, so each build records them in runtime-manifest.json with the compiler version. CI builds in the same pinned swift:6.2.3-noble image the app is tested in (glibc 2.39, libstdc++ from GCC 13).
